facts.text: The resort sits in Nusa Dua on a clifftop and beachside setting.
facts.excerpt: The Ritz-Carlton, Bali is a Nusa Dua luxury resort benefiting from a stunning clifftop and beachside setting.

facts.text: The resort opened in early 2015.
facts.excerpt: Opened in early 2015, the Ritz-Carlton Bali marked the brand's return to the island

facts.text: The Villa Collection villas were designed by Burega Farnell.
facts.excerpt: Discover the signature collection villas designed by Burega Farnell.

facts.text: Villas include private pools.
facts.excerpt: Villas include private pools where guests can experience the floating breakfast.

facts.text: A floating breakfast is offered to guests in villas or suites with pool or lagoon access.
facts.excerpt: While staying in one of our villas or suites with pool or lagoon access, treat yourself to the perfect start to a vacation day.

facts.text: The floating breakfast is for in-house guests and costs extra.
facts.excerpt: This service is available to in-house guests and is subject to an additional charge.

facts.text: Bejana by Petty Elliott serves Indonesian cuisine and hosts cooking classes at the Culinary Cave.
facts.excerpt: This cliff-top restaurant in Bali's Nusa Dua celebrates Indonesian cuisine both on its menu and with cooking classes at the Culinary Cave.

facts.text: Balinese Buffet Night is held every Saturday at Bejana.
facts.excerpt: Available every Saturday at Bejana Indonesian Restaurant.

facts.text: Senses is a beachfront restaurant whose breakfast buffet spans Western, Chinese, Japanese, Indonesian and Indian dishes.
facts.excerpt: This beachfront restaurant in Nusa Dua offers an extensive menu, including an international breakfast buffet with a variety of Western, Chinese, Japanese, Indonesian, and Indian dishes

facts.text: Spa treatments use natural ingredients of the beach and ocean, including pearls and seaweed.
facts.excerpt: Spa treatments incorporate natural ingredients of the beach and ocean including pearls and seaweed

facts.text: The spa's Hydro-Vital Pool has hydrotherapy zones that each target a different area of the body.
facts.excerpt: The Hydro-Vital Pool has five different zones each targeting a different area of the body.

facts.text: The Yoga Studio offers a daily schedule of complimentary classes for all levels.
facts.excerpt: The Yoga Studio at this Nusa Dua hotel and spa offers a daily schedule of complimentary classes suited to all levels

facts.text: Children aged 4 to 12 can join Ritz Kids without a parent.
facts.excerpt: Kids aged 4 - 12 years can join Ritz Kids without being accompanied by parents.

facts.text: The Ritz Kids program is free and needs no reservation.
facts.excerpt: The Ritz Kids program is free of charge, and no reservation is required

facts.text: The resort partners with the Bali Sea Turtle Society to protect hatching sea turtles.
facts.excerpt: the resort partners with the Bali Sea Turtle Society to protect the hatching sea turtles.

facts.text: The sea turtle release program is seasonal, so guests should check availability.
facts.excerpt: We kindly request you to check the availability of this program, due to its seasonal nature.

facts.text: The Balinese soul purification ritual, Melukat, takes place on the resort's beach in the early morning.
facts.excerpt: the Soul Purification Ritual takes place on the secluded white beaches of the resort in the early morning

facts.text: The concierge team curates a guided excursion to Uluwatu Temple.
facts.excerpt: Embark on a guided cultural excursion curated by our concierge team to explore the majestic Uluwatu Temple

facts.text: From the lobby it is about a 10-minute walk down to the water.
facts.excerpt: once you pop down the towering glass elevator, it’s only about a 10-minute walk to the water

facts.text: The nearest airport, Ngurah Rai International (DPS), is approximately 16.8 km from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: I Gusti Ngurah Rai International Airport - Bali (DPS). DPS is located approximately 16.8 KM from the hotel.

facts.text: Pets are not allowed.
facts.excerpt: No, pets are not allowed at The Ritz-Carlton, Bali.

facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler Readers' Choice Awards listed for 2018, 2020, 2023, 2024 and 2025.
facts.excerpt: Readers' Choice Awards 2018, 2020, 2023, 2024, 2025
